hypothesis: The fixed author-provided model 000 predicts the recorded contrast polarity for at least 18 of 24 known non-input labels under the upstream circular-flash protocol; an independent FRI calculation agrees with the upstream implementation.
selection: Model 000, selected by lowest numeric identifier before reading response or validation-loss values; author-provided best_chkpt is used without selecting another model after evaluation.

license.scope: MIT notice supplied alongside author model archive; retain attribution. Separate training/stimulus datasets are not acquired or cleared.

network.checkpoint_loading: torch.load(weights_only=True, map_location=cpu), strict state dictionary; no fallback or extra globals
network.inference_transform: Apply upstream Network.clamp before recording working-state digest; upstream time constants are bounded by dt during integration.

stimulus.recording: central cell of each of 65 modeled labels

biological_reference.classification: Literature-compiled polarity labels from pinned upstream groundtruth_utils.py; not raw electrophysiology recordings
biological_reference.threshold_rationale: A scoped preregistered 75% agreement requirement above the 14/24 constant-majority baseline; not an effect size taken from the publication.

criteria.PASS_SCOPED_REFERENCE_CHECK: All artifact/provenance/finite/repeat/FRI-implementation checks pass and at least 18 of 24 known non-input labels match their recorded polarity.
criteria.REJECT_SCOPED_HYPOTHESIS: A completed compliant run fails repeat, FRI agreement or the preregistered 18/24 polarity requirement. Preserve failures; do not substitute a better model.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Provenance, compatibility, resource, unsupported checkpoint or runtime failure prevents valid measurement.
criteria.promotion: This check never establishes full-paper replication, market validity or live execution permission; new criteria require a new experiment ID.

controls: independent FRI implementation compared against upstream FRI on identical saved responses
topology_controls: Not a claim of topology causality, biological superiority or market performance; broader controls remain required for those claims.
train_validation_test_windows: Not applicable: author pretrained model, synthetic flash checks only; no training performed.
known_limitations: One fixed model is not the publication ensemble or its best-performing model.
Two CT1 compartment labels represent one biological cell type; 65 model labels correspond to 64 biological types.
Known labels, T4/T5 subtypes and CT1 compartments are dependent; no IID binomial significance is claimed.
Source-level agreement and same-environment repeats do not establish independent execution attestation.
No moving-edge direction tuning, full 26-study replication, training-data audit, learned market encoder or market benchmark.
A virtual environment and Python guards are not an OS security sandbox.
